headline: Mugur Isărescu's warning to the Government: Avoid procyclical policies. Avoid introducing incentives into the economy when the economy is growing
summary: BNR Governor Mugur Isărescu said Romania can sustain convergence toward Western living standards only with careful management of macroeconomic balances. He urged avoiding incentives while the economy is growing.
why: The National Bank of Romania sets monetary policy and its guidance shapes the leu, inflation expectations and Romanian government bond yields.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Avertismentul lui Mugur Isărescu pentru Guvern: Evitaţi politicile prociclice. Evitaţi ca atunci când economia creşte să mai introduceţi stimulente în economie
